summary: Comprehensive V2 testing completed for Shrimad Bhagavat Katha Mahotsav 2026 event website. All new features from the massive UI/UX overhaul are working correctly: golden temple door overlay, bilingual EN/HI language toggle, simplified 3-step registration form, reordered sections, and new backend schema.
passed_tests: Golden temple door overlay appears on first load with Hindi text 'पवित्र द्वार खोलें' and 'प्रवेश करें'
Clicking door overlay triggers opening animation and enters the site
Door overlay disappears after animation completes (~1.8s)
Language toggle (EN/HI) in navbar switches ALL content between English and Hindi
Default language is Hindi as expected
Hero section displays title, countdown timer (59 days), date, location, and action buttons
Hero section shows Krishna image and floating particles animation
All 11 sections render correctly: Loving Memory, About, Vyas Peeth, Schedule, Special Programs, Episodes, Venue, Registration CTA, Family, Contact, Footer
Navbar navigation scrolls to correct sections (tested Schedule)
Sticky register button appears on scroll
Registration form: 3-step flow working (Contact -> Attendance -> Attendees + Accommodation)
Registration form Step 1: Full name, mobile, email, city, country fields
Registration form Step 2: Attendance intent (Yes/Most Probably/Maybe), dates, days attending, num_people
Registration form Step 3: Attendee details, accommodation toggle, room type, consent checkbox, summary
Registration form validation: name required error shown in Hindi
Registration form validation: mobile required error shown in Hindi
Registration form validation: consent required error shown in Hindi
Registration form submission successful - POST /api/registrations
Registration success page shows with WhatsApp notification button
WhatsApp redirect links to correct number +917229900422
Admin login at /admin with admin@example.com / admin123 - POST /api/auth/login
Admin dashboard shows summary cards: Total Registrations, Total People, Accommodation Needed, Total Rooms
Admin dashboard shows attendance intent breakdown: Confirmed (Yes), Most Probably, Maybe
Admin registrations table shows new schema fields: Intent, People, Accommodation
Admin registration detail dialog opens with organized sections
Admin CSV export button present - GET /api/admin/export-csv
Admin logout button present
Backend API: All 15 tests passed (100% success rate)
Backend API: POST /api/registrations with new simplified schema
Backend API: GET /api/admin/summary returns attendance_intent aggregations
Backend API: Authentication with httpOnly cookies working
Venue section has Google Maps embed working
Contact buttons (call and WhatsApp) are functional
Sound toggle button in navbar for flute audio
